sessions.intent: Bring PLang's NuGet packages up to date, one package per commit, the suites holding at runtime2's baseline

before.assumptions: Each package is a drop-in except where its major changes an API. ImageSharp 4.x changes the screen module's and DetectFormat's calls. NSec 26 is the one signing rests on.
before.risk: A major breaking an API beyond a mechanical fix (stop and report). Roslyn moving past the SDK's compiler.

actions.context: Packages to latest, one per commit; Roslyn kept at 4.13.0 as ruled (packages 3)
Fluid 2.40 asks for an include by its name as written first; one key per include; the file left better (packages 3)
Nethereum and Newtonsoft out, Keccak from BouncyCastle (Ingi's wish, packages 3)
An older race: the flag was set before the value on a shared catalog row; TUnit 1.76's scheduling exposed it
ImageSharp 4 needs a licence key for any non-Debug build: stopped, and reported to Ingi via the architect

after.status: blocked on the ImageSharp licence decision
after.health: Debug sweep at baseline (Wire's six), plang 298/303; the gate passes with ImageSharp at 2.1.13 only
after.notes: No vulnerable package in any project after the upgrades
